messages.content: Extract boundary traversal only. Do not judge story validity or physical possibility. Return JSON only.

BOUND BARRIER
steel gate

PROTECTED DESTINATION
courtyard

RAW SCENE
The ball rolls from the road through the gateway and stops in the courtyard.

Classify only whether RAW SCENE establishes that any person, creature, object, body part, or other physical thing crosses the boundary of PROTECTED DESTINATION during the scene. Return TRAVERSED when RAW explicitly shows or states movement from outside the destination to inside it, from inside to outside it, or through BOUND BARRIER. The barrier noun does not need to be repeated if the destination crossing itself is explicit. Return NOT_TRAVERSED when things only approach, strike, wait near, remain on one side, or are already inside/outside without crossing during this scene. Return UNSPECIFIED when the scene gives different start/end sides but does not establish how the change occurred, or when spatial information is insufficient. Do not infer an unseen route. Do not decide whether crossing is allowed. Return JSON: {"status":"..."}

message.reasoning:
We need to parse the RAW SCENE: "The ball rolls from the road through the gateway and stops in the courtyard."

Bound barrier: steel gate.

Protected destination: courtyard.

So we have a ball rolling from the road, through the gateway (which is presumably the boundary), into the courtyard. So it crosses the boundary of protected destination. The ball moves from outside to inside. That qualifies as TRAVERSED. Return JSON {"status":"TRAVERSED"}
